image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a heavy agricultural plow attached to the rear of a tractor. The image features two large, curved metal moldboards (shares) in the foreground, showing signs of wear and soil residue. Behind them is the dark metal frame of the plow and the large, treaded tire of the tractor. The background is a blurred field with dry grass.
